source_text: Judicabit autem et pseudoprophetas, qui non accepta a ee prophetica gratia nec Deum timentes, sed aut propter vanam gloriam, aut ad questum aliquem, aut et aliter secundum operationem mali spiritus, fingunt se prophetare, mentientes adversus Quemadmodum judicabuntur qui schismata operantur, et omnes qui se segregant ab Ecclesia: et quemadmodum omnia constant et qui est Ecclesiasticus. 1. Jupicasnrr autem et eos qui schismata operantur, qui sunt inanes, non habentes Dei dilectionem, suamque utilitatem potius considerantes quam unitatem Ecclesiz : et propter modicas et quaslibet causas magnum et gloriosum corpus Christi conscindunt et dividunt, et quantum in ipsis est, interficiunt: pacem loquentes et bellum operantes: vere liquantes culicem et cametransglutientes. Nulla enim ab eis tanta potest fieri correctio, quanta est schismatis pernicies. Judicabit autem et omnes eos qui sunt extra veritatem, id est qui sunt extra Ecclesiam: ipse autem a nemine judicabitur. Omnia enim ei constant: et in unum Deum omnipotentem, ex quo omnia, fides integra; et in nat eis +O Filium Dei Christum Jesum Dominum nostrum, per quem omnia, — et dispositiones ejus, per quas homo factus est Filius Dei, sententia firma, quze est in Spiritu Dei, qui preestat agnitionem veritatis, qui dispositiones Patris et Filii exposuit, secundum quas aderat generi humano, quemadmodum vult Pater.
thought_title: Judgment of False Prophets and Schismatics
pass_a_gloss: He will judge, however, also the false prophets, who, not having received the prophetic gift from Him, nor fearing God, but either on account of empty glory, or for some gain, or also in another manner according to the operation of the evil spirit, feign themselves to prophesy, lying against; and how they will be judged who work schisms, and all who separate themselves from the Church: and all things are constant and the one who is Ecclesiastic is constant; But He will judge also those who work schisms, who are empty, not having the love of God, and considering their own utility rather than the unity of the Church; and on account of minor and whatever causes, they cut and divide the great and glorious body of Christ, and as far as it is in them, they kill; speaking peace and working war; truly straining out a gnat and swallowing a camel; for no such great correction can be made by them as is the destruction of schism; He will judge, however, also all those who are outside the truth, that is, who are outside the Church; He Himself, however, will be judged by no one; for all things are constant for Him; and in one God, omnipotent, from whom all things, complete faith; and in the Son of God, Christ Jesus our Lord, through whom all things, and the dispositions of Him, through which man was made the Son of God, firm sentence, which is in the Spirit of God, who supplies the knowledge of truth, who explained the dispositions of the Father and the Son, according to which He was present to the human race, as the Father wills

pass_b_english: He will also judge the false prophets who have not received the prophetic gift from Him, who do not fear God, but who feign themselves to prophesy either for the sake of empty glory, or for some gain, or in some other way according to the working of the evil spirit, lying against Him. He will judge in just the same way those who work schisms and all who separate themselves from the Church. All things hold firm, and the one who belongs to the Church holds firm.

He will also judge those who work schisms—those who are empty, lacking the love of God, and considering their own advantage rather than the unity of the Church. On account of minor and trivial causes they cut apart and divide the great and glorious body of Christ, and as far as it lies in their power, they kill it. They speak peace but wage war. They truly strain out a gnat yet swallow a camel, for no correction they might make can equal the destruction wrought by schism.

He will also judge all those who are outside the truth—that is, those who are outside the Church. He Himself, however, will be judged by no one. For all things hold firm for Him: complete faith in one God Almighty, from whom all things come; and in the Son of God, Christ Jesus our Lord, through whom all things exist. The ordering of His becoming, by which man was made a son of God, stands as a firm decree in the Spirit of God, who supplies the knowledge of truth and who has declared the orderings of the Father and the Son, according to which He was present to the human race, just as the Father willed.

review.notes: Pass A and Pass B both fail to correctly translate the Latin 'mentientes adversus Quemadmodum judicabuntur'. The Latin text contains a fragment 'mentientes adversus' (lying against [Him/the truth]) followed immediately by 'Quemadmodum judicabuntur' (Just as they will be judged). Pass A renders this as 'lying against; and how they will be judged', which is a grammatical fragment. Pass B attempts to repair this by adding 'Him' ('lying against Him') and 'in just the same way' ('He will judge in just the same way'), which are interpolations not present in the provided Locked Latin. Furthermore, the Latin 'quze est in Spiritu Dei' (likely an OCR error for 'quae est') is translated in Pass A as 'which is in the Spirit of God' and in Pass B as 'stands as a firm decree in the Spirit of God', but the connection to the preceding 'sententia firma' is handled with varying degrees of interpretive liberty. Most critically, the phrase 'mentientes adversus Quemadmodum' is a broken transition in the source, and both translations attempt to smooth it by adding content ('Him', 'in just the same way') not found in the provided text.
uncertainties: The phrase 'mentientes adversus Quemadmodum' is syntactically broken in the source; Pass B adds 'Him' to resolve it.
reasons: Pass B adds 'Him' to 'lying against' which is not in the Locked Latin: 'mentientes adversus Quemadmodur'.
Pass B adds 'in just the same way' to 'Quemadmodum judicabuntur' which is not in the Locked Latin: 'Quemadmodum judicabuntur'.
